# GroupDocs.Markdown.Mcp.Tests

Integration tests and deployment how-to guides for GroupDocs.Markdown.Mcp — the MCP server that exposes GroupDocs.Markdown for .NET to AI agents (Claude, Cursor, VS Code / GitHub Copilot, and other MCP-compatible clients) for converting documents to Markdown.

This repo validates the **published NuGet artifact** end-to-end and doubles as a reference for using it from every supported channel.

## Primary repository

- MCP server source + package: https://github.com/groupdocs-markdown/GroupDocs.Markdown.Mcp
- NuGet package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/GroupDocs.Markdown.Mcp
- Docker images: ghcr.io/groupdocs-markdown/markdown-net-mcp and docker.io/groupdocs/markdown-net-mcp

## Deployment channels covered by how-to guides

- how-to/01-install-from-nuget.md — dnx (recommended) + global dotnet tool
- how-to/02-run-via-docker.md — container image + docker-compose
- how-to/03-verify-mcp-registry.md — MCP registry discovery and NuGet.org auto-generated mcp.json
- how-to/04-use-with-claude-desktop.md — Claude Desktop stdio config
- how-to/05-use-with-vscode-copilot.md — VS Code / GitHub Copilot config with prompt-string inputs
- how-to/06-run-integration-tests.md — run this repo's test suite locally and in CI

## MCP tools exposed by the server

- convert_to_markdown — convert a document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, EPUB, MOBI, …) to clean, structured Markdown; images embed as base64 by default
- get_document_info — return file format, page count, title, author, and encryption flag as JSON

Reverse Markdown → document composition (compose_from_markdown) is NOT exposed — `MarkdownConverter.FromMarkdownString` throws NotImplementedException in GroupDocs.Markdown 26.3.0. Use the GroupDocs.Conversion MCP for Markdown → DOCX / PDF / HTML in the interim.

## Environment variables

- GROUPDOCS_MCP_STORAGE_PATH — base folder for input + output (defaults to current working directory)
- GROUPDOCS_MCP_OUTPUT_PATH — optional, routes output files to a separate folder
- GROUPDOCS_LICENSE_PATH — path to GroupDocs.Total.lic; omit for evaluation mode (converted Markdown may be limited / carry an evaluation notice)

## Key facts for AI agents

- Testing the shipped NuGet, not the source. No project reference to the server.
- Tool names on the wire are snake_case: convert_to_markdown, get_document_info.
- The suite passes fully unlicensed — GroupDocs.Markdown's Convert() succeeds in evaluation mode (limited output, no exception). A license only removes the limits.
- Real document fixtures live in Files/ (from the upstream examples repo). No synthetic fixtures.
- Target framework is net10.0 only. Requires .NET 10 SDK for dnx.
